_source: https://sts2.untapped.gg/en/tier-list/cards/silent (pulled 2026-08-26); pick_rate is empirical Act 1 pick rate from real Silent runs, used as a base strength prior
_notes: tags drive synergy scoring in cards.py. multiplayer_only cards are down-weighted hard since the bot only plays singleplayer. 'sly' cards can be discarded from hand to trigger their effect for free instead of being played for cost -- this is the Silent's core STS2 win condition, so sly + discard_engine tags reinforce each other.
